claim.statement: Parent_6 and parent_8 both correctly handle x0<8 but fail at x0>=18 because they use a single linear extension. The data clearly shows three segments with different slope/intercept by parity. The even subsequence for 8<=x0<18 descends by 1 each step (12,11,10,9,8), then jumps to 43,42 for x0>=18. The odd subsequence for 8<=x0<18 ascends by 1 (21,22,23,24,25), then jumps to 62,63. This suggests a piecewise-linear-by-parity structure with segment breaks at 8 and 18.
